text:
Maya K: Quick check — SOC2 evidence handoff: who owns the final CSV export for KMS key rotations? We're blocked; audit pipeline is dropping rows for some keys.
Siddharth R: I can take ownership of the CSV export. Observed blocker: staging/prod have different retention TTLs which surfaced the mismatch. @Joel P any idea?
Joel P: TTL mismatch unlikely the root cause. The pipeline trims columns when a row > 100 cols, so the export ends up malformed. Ops has a small patch to avoid truncation but we need a rollout owner.
Anna L: Security needs the rotation + attestation events in the 'key_events' column exactly as the template. Can we ensure HSM attestation events map into that column? :eyes:
Ops Eng: Patch queued in infra repo (PR #3456). Rollout plan proposed: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. We need a DRI to kick off canary and validate artifact integrity.
Security Bot: [automated] auditlog-monitor: missing KMS rotation events in staging in the last 24h (alert id: AL-2043).
Maya K: DRI ask: @Siddharth R can you run the canary and verify the CSVs include key_events + attest fields? Also need to set a milestone on SOC2 board: evidence-ready by Thu EOD (2043274800).
Siddharth R: I can run the canary today at 17:00 PST. Need the test-data config from Joel. Example we used locally:
```yaml
audit_export:
  include: [key_rotate, attest]
  max_cols: 200
  include_metadata: true
```
Joel P: will push the sanitized test dataset and small schema migration to the infra branch before 16:00. Note: the pipeline image needs bump to v2.1 to include the fix — eng-infra will have to approve. tagging @eng-infra
Ops Eng: Acknowledged. After PR merge I'll queue the image bump and start the canary. ETA ~3h post-merge.
Anna L: Security will validate the canary output against the evidence checklist (schema + presence of attest signatures). If it passes we'll add signoff comment on the PR. :thumbsup:
Maya K: Perfect. I'll update the SOC2 board: create milestone 'KMS evidence export + attestation' with owners @Siddharth R (canary), @Joel P (schema), @Ops Eng (rollout). Will check back after canary.
Siddharth R: One more thing — if the pipeline still truncates rows, we should add a temporary pre-check that rejects exports with missing key_events and fail fast. I can add that to the canary validator.
Joel P: Good call. I'll include a schema check in the PR CI that fails on missing columns.
Ops Eng: Will coordinate rollout window with infra (non-peak hours). Posting canary results back in this thread once done.
Maya K: Thanks everyone — low-bandwidth async is perfect here. If anything blocks the canary, ping the channel and I'll escalate.
